verdict.rationale: SES supports rule-based automation: receipt rules can trigger Lambda functions, S3 storage, SNS topics, or WorkMail delivery on incoming mail, and configuration sets can publish sending events (bounce, complaint, delivery, etc.) to CloudWatch, EventBridge, SNS, Firehose, or Pinpoint based on defined characteristics — this is a genuine event-triggered rules/actions automation capability applicable to any consumer including AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of these automation rules working reliably in production, and no AI-specific integration examples beyond generic event routing.
